high_level_description: The image is a screenshot from a social media platform, likely Instagram, showing an "Explore" post by the user "@thelogicbook." The post features a photograph of a densely built urban area with rows of houses and trees lining the streets. The houses appear to be residential, with varying architectural styles, and the area is well-organized. The text overlay on the image provides information about the "3-30-300 Rule," which is a principle in urban planning. It states that everyone should be able to see at least 3 trees from their home, with a 30% vegetation cover in each neighborhood
